zh.contrastThreshold: 阈值：≤17pt 文本 4.5:1、≥18pt 或粗体 3:1、非文本 3:1。比值按 WCAG 相对亮度公式从计算色值现算
zh.contrastNote: 这是量出来的，不是评出来的：三级文字（13px 说明、10px 状态标签用的都是它）在浅色底上约 3.7:1，够不到 4.5:1；hairline 分隔线本来就不在白名单里（WCAG 对纯装饰性分隔不设阈值），列出来只为对照 3:1 那条建议。产品自身如此，本仓库不覆盖官方控件（见 00-overview 的冲突处理），按「已知偏差」记录。
zh.hitIntro: 左：16 × 16 的图标按钮只有视觉尺寸，热区就是 16 × 16 → 小于最小 20 × 20。右：同一个按钮用 ::before 把热区扩到 28 × 28（inset −6px），视觉尺寸没变
zh.focusIntroLead: 按 Tab 走进这两组按钮：上面一组的焦点环完整；下面一组被容器
zh.focusIntroTail: 裁掉一半，所以规范要求改用内偏移（outline-offset 为负）
zh.grayTitle: 4 · 颜色是不是唯一的信息载体（AC-MF-07）
zh.grayIntro: 点按钮把彩色抽掉：只靠颜色的那一行，灰度后两个状态会变得难以区分；带图标的那一行不会

en.contrastThreshold: Thresholds: text ≤17pt 4.5:1, ≥18pt or bold 3:1, non-text 3:1. The ratio is computed live from the resolved colour values with the WCAG relative-luminance formula
en.contrastNote: This one is measured, not judged: tertiary text (what 13px captions and 10px state labels use) sits at about 3.7:1 on a light surface, short of 4.5:1; the hairline divider was never on the list anyway (WCAG sets no threshold for a purely decorative divider) and is listed only to compare against the 3:1 recommendation. The product ships this way, and this repository does not override official controls (see the conflict handling in 00-overview), so it is recorded as a known deviation.
en.hitIntro: Left: a 16 × 16 icon button carries only its visual size, so the hit area is 16 × 16 → below the 20 × 20 minimum. Right: the same button extends the hit area to 28 × 28 with ::before (inset −6px), and the visual size does not change
en.focusIntroLead: Press Tab through these two groups: the focus ring in the upper group stays whole; in the lower group the container
en.focusIntroTail: clips it in half, so the spec asks for an inset focus style instead (a negative outline-offset)
en.grayTitle: 4 · Is colour the only carrier of information (AC-MF-07)
en.grayIntro: Press the button to strip the colour out: in the row that relies on colour alone, the two states become hard to tell apart once greyscaled; the row with icons does not
